title: Discover Monroe - West Monroe opens Restaurant Week application - NewsBreak
text:
12 hours ago
WEST MONROE, La. ( KTVE/KARD ) — Discover Monroe-West Monroe is now accepting applications for Monroe-West Monroe Restaurant Week 2026 from restaurants across Ouachita Parish. The deadline to apply is Friday, July 31, 2026.
Restaurant Week will take place September 14-20, 2026, as Discover Monroe-West Monroe encourages both visitors and locals to explore the Twin Cities’ vibrant culinary scene. Participating restaurants will offer fixed-price menu options for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. For more information, visit: https://www.monroe-westmonroe.org/mwm-restaurant-week/
There is no cost to participate, and all restaurants throughout Ouachita Parish are eligible to apply. For more information or to request an application, contact Discover Monroe-West Monroe Vice President of Marketing and Communications Sheila Snow at ssnow@monroe-westmonroe.org.
